fiber-laser-marking-machine.question: What materials can be marked with this Fiber Laser Marking Machine?
fiber-laser-marking-machine.answer: This machine marks all metals including stainless steel, mild steel, aluminum, brass, copper, titanium, gold, silver, platinum, as well as selected engineering plastics and coated materials.

fiber-laser-marking-machine.question: Which laser power option should I choose (20W, 30W, 50W, 100W)?
fiber-laser-marking-machine.answer: 20W and 30W are ideal for standard surface marking, serial numbers, barcodes, and logos. 50W and 100W provide higher marking speeds, deeper engraving, and metal cutting (such as gold/silver jewellery sheets).
